- Moving off the grid or into a static obstacle leaves the agent where it is.

  probability >= 0.7 for each k.

1. **Make progress toward the next unreached goal.** `toward` moves reduce the row or column gap, and `closer` moves follow a shortest free path. Either way the distance to the goal shrinks, so the agent cannot circle.

```json
  {"condition": "toward & !wall & !obstacle & !patrol & !early", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "closer & !wall & !obstacle & !early", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!wall & !obstacle & !early", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "true", "action": "up"}
]}
```
